{"code": "
import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get scan object
scan = application.Scan

# Set scan parameters for 30x30 µm² image
scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Get current parameters to verify
print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth * 1e6} µm")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight * 1e6} µm")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan (using StartFrameUp to minimize tip damage)
print("\nStarting AFM scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the saved file path
# The scan should be automatically saved in the workspace
workspace_path = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_3_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_3"

# List files to find the newly created scan
print(f"\nWorkspace path: {workspace_path}")

del spm
"}
